summary: Duplicate payment run line created by matching-rule fallback after PO line UUID normalization
description:
Issue summary:
A payment run for vendor V-0912 (scheduled 2026-03-09) contains duplicate debit lines for the same invoice due to the matching service falling back to a normalized PO-line UUID. The fallback path created a secondary match entry that progressed through the payment scheduler, resulting in two payout rows for the same invoice in the payout_batch table.

Impact:
- Two payment entries were created for one invoice (INV-2026-7345) which would cause double-payment if the batch is not halted.
- Affected vendor payouts are currently in 'pending_bank_submission' state, blocking settlement reconciliation.
- Potential exposure: reconciliation discrepancy for weekly payrun; finance team requested immediate pause of related payruns.

Environment:
- Production (us-east)
- Payments-service v3.7.1 deployed 2026-03-07
- Matching microservice v1.12.0
- Database: payments-prod-cluster (Postgres 13, primary)
steps_to_reproduce: Create a test vendor with PO that has legacy PO-line IDs (hyphenated UUIDs).
Ingest invoice with invoice_line referencing legacy PO-line id 'po-0a7b-...-c3d4'.
Run matching job which attempts exact match then falls back to normalized PO-line UUID (strip hyphens/upper/lower).
Observe matching-service creating two match records (exact and normalized fallback).
Trigger payment scheduler for the same invoice; confirm two payout rows created in payout_batch table referencing same invoice_id.
expected_behavior: Matching service should dedupe fallback-produced matches for the same invoice/po_line combination and produce at most one payout row per invoice per payrun.
actual_behavior: Matching service produced a fallback match that did not de-duplicate against an existing exact match, causing the payment scheduler to enqueue/pay the same invoice twice.
logs_and_artifacts: payments-service logs: 2026-03-09T02:14:07Z ERROR payout-enqueue duplicate invoice_id=INV-2026-7345 batch_id=PB-8814
db snapshot: SELECT * FROM payout_batch WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-7345' returned two rows (ids: 77213, 77214)
payment scheduler trace: scheduler_run=2026-03-09T02:15:00Z enqueued 2 rows for invoice INV-2026-7345
investigation_notes:
Initial triage by payments on-call: confirmed duplicate rows exist in payout_batch and both rows progressed to 'pending_bank_submission'. Root cause hypothesis: matching-service fallback path normalizes PO-line UUIDs (removing hyphens and lowercasing) but does not check for dedup against existing exact-match records; dedup logic only runs in the primary matching path. Reproducible with legacy-format PO-line ids.

Additional findings:
- The matching-service recent change (PR 4310) introduced normalization logic last week; it passed unit tests but no integration test covered dedupe with both paths.
- The scheduler consumes match records idempotently by match_record_id; because fallback created a second distinct match_record_id, scheduler treated it as a separate payout.
- Payment-run locking prevented auto-submission pause; need manual intervention to stop bank submission for batch PB-8814.

Next steps proposed:
1) Run DB transaction to mark one of the payout_batch rows for invoice INV-2026-7345 as 'voided' and remove from bank submission queue (Finance approval required).
2) Hotfix matching-service: add dedupe check in fallback path (check for existing match on invoice_id + normalized_po_line). Prepare PR and expedited review.
3) Add integration test to payments-service to simulate legacy PO-line formats and ensure dedupe.
4) Postmortem and release note; add monitoring alert for "payout_batch duplicate invoice rows".

2026-03-12 - Ethan Morales: PR opened for matching-service hotfix: github.com/redwood-inference/matching-service/pull/4399. Hotfix adds dedupe check and a metrics counter 'matching.fallback.dedupe_skipped' for visibility.
2026-03-13 - Head of Payments (Marisol Vega): Finance approved voiding duplicate row 77214 and reconciliation entry created. Please include postmortem and final verification before closing ticket.
resolution: Duplicate payout row (id 77214) voided after Finance approval. Manual hold prevented bank submission. Hotfix merged and deployed to prod 2026-03-13 (matching-service v1.12.1) with dedupe check in fallback path. Integration test added to CI. Follow-up: create an alert on 'payout_batch_duplicate_invoice_count > 0' and run a one-week audit of payruns covering 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-09 for similar occurrences.
